subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should this PR be allowed to broadly raise the unset QMD embed timeout default from 120s to 600s now, or should merge wait for real QMD/GGUF proof or a narrower default strategy?
rationale: The code change is small, but it changes existing users' unset QMD runtime and lock-wait behavior; the contributor's proof shows the source/test change, not the real long-running QMD/GGUF runtime path.

options.title: Require proof or narrow the default
options.body: Hold the PR until redacted real QMD/GGUF runtime proof is supplied, or change the implementation to a narrower selective or opt-in timeout strategy.

options.title: Accept the broad default
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the CPU and lock-wait tradeoff and merge after normal review despite the missing live QMD proof.

options.title: Defer to the broader draft
options.body: Pause this PR only if https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99166 becomes ready, proof-positive, and accepted as the canonical broader QMD fix.

recommendation.title: Require proof or narrow the default
recommendation.body: Hold the PR until redacted real QMD/GGUF runtime proof is supplied, or change the implementation to a narrower selective or opt-in timeout strategy.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to osolmaz and recent history shows adjacent QMD config/runtime ownership.
